data.narrative:
BlackSea Technologies is a platform-stage Defense & Security company currently valued at $650M. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 14 private peers in the same sector and valuation tier, alongside 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic, which range from $300M to $3.0B in valuation.

The peer-median method, the primary applicable triangulation approach, yields an implied valuation of $1.1B based on the median across all 14 same-sector comparables. This method is supported by a relatively tight peer distribution: the 25th percentile sits at $973M and the 75th percentile at $1.3B. Named peers like Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B), True Anomaly ($2.2B, Series D), and Onebrief ($2.1B, Series D) anchor the upper end, while the broader distribution captures heterogeneity in stage and commercialization maturity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $973M to $1.3B, with a median point estimate of $1.1B—representing a 70% uplift from the current $650M valuation. The primary uncertainty stems from single-method triangulation; revenue multiples, margin profiles, and customer concentration data would strengthen conviction. Stage progression velocity and differentiation within the Defense & Security subsector also warrant deeper investigation before final commitment.
